shared_elements: repeated small motifs arranged in rows/bands (A wall pattern; B rows of discs on chest)
curved paired projections (A bull horns; B head-side appendages)
justification: The only correspondences are generic: both surfaces carry small repeated motifs set out in horizontal rows (rows of red marks on the wall in A, rows of discs across the chest in B) and both handle form schematically rather than naturalistically. Otherwise the content is wholly different: A shows a horned bovine skull and installed horn cores against a wall with abstract painted patterning, while B shows a single monumental anthropomorphic figure with head, shoulders, arms and body ornament, with no animal and no equivalent to A's bucranium-and-bench arrangement.
